Actual startup checker initially expected pm path of an absent package to exit0; API29 returns exit1 with empty output. The checker now explicitly accepts only exit0/1 plus empty output for fresh-guest absence. Initial failure and exact owned cleanup retained. This was a test expectation defect, not an application repair.

The next actual checker incorrectly demanded byte-identical SQLite copies across reopen. Independent read-only diagnosis proves exact schema/data equality and changes only at SQLite file-change/version-valid-for counter bytes 27/95. Corrected qualification retains raw hashes, requires the same device inode, complete logical-content digest, schema/version/counts/size and all bytes outside header counter words. No seeded data, wipe, product repair or acceptance-test relaxation. Empty-scaffold retention is not proof of later populated account/game recovery.

One full service regression completed lifecycle/failure/native cleanup but its final assertion saw unrelated ::1 port34001 under PID16360 disappear. No concurrent Python socket suite was running; its exact cause is not established. The diagnostic is retained. Repeated complete qualification passes the identical unchanged unrelated-listener assertion; no broker/unrelated listener was stopped and no runtime/Windows helper assertion was weakened.

All 18 new focused Python checks are mocked controller/unit tests, not actual guest inductions. Actual guest checks cover invalid/wrong-package artifact refusal, stopped-app capture timeout, successful install/startup/capture/reinstall/relaunch and native cleanup. Wrong launcher, changed signer/input/installed identity, malformed XML/PNG, binary timeout and active-journal refusal have focused regressions, not fabricated actual-device pass claims.

Raw database inspection is read-only corroboration and refuses a nonempty journal/WAL; it is not a live snapshot/export facility for future feature writes or a replacement for I01f2 instrumentation.
